source: Residency alone does not guarantee progress. A resident warp may be waiting for a memory dependency, an arithmetic result, synchronization, or another event. A warp whose next instruction can issue is eligible. Schedulers select among eligible warps and issue instructions to the appropriate pipelines.[3]
zh: 仅居住权并不能保证进步。常驻扭曲可能正在等待内存依赖性、算术结果、同步或其他事件。下一条指令可以发出的扭曲是合格的。调度程序在符合条件的扭曲中进行选择并向适当的管道发出指令。 [3]
